_comment: nvitk dataset and atlas configuration. Copy to a config directory (see
'db.root' is the one key most commands need: it points at an nvitk dataset directory
(the one containing 'catalog/repository.json'). Everything else is optional.

_comment_dvc: Used by `nvitk-dataset pull` to fetch the dataset with DVC.
dvc_repo       - repository holding the .dvc pointer files (public).
dvc_remote_url - where the actual content lives. Only reachable by people with
access to that storage; leave empty to use the repository default.
External users: leave these empty and point 'root' at your own dataset, or create one
with DatasetCatalog.create_scaffold(). See the Installation docs.
_comment_statmodels: Where the Stats GUI saves model configurations, reports and exports. Kept separate from
the dataset because these are a researcher's own working output, written far more often
than the dataset changes. Defaults to <root>/nvitk-statmodels when unset.
_comment_fallback: local_fallback_root takes precedence over root when set — it exists so a laptop can
point at a local copy without editing 'root'. Leave it null unless you need it.
db._comment_sge: Dataset root as seen from inside a cluster job / container.
db._comment_raw: Optional roots for raw acquisition data, if not under the dataset.
_comment_scaffold: auto_scaffold creates an empty dataset skeleton when 'root' points somewhere that is
not a dataset yet. Keep it false unless you are deliberately creating one, so that a
mistyped path fails loudly instead of silently producing an empty dataset.
_comment_xnat: Optional inline XNAT connection. Prefer a separate xnat.json (see xnat.example.json)
— this block bypasses the netrc/keyring credential chain.

_comment: Parcellations used for brain/vascular figures. 'root' is a directory nvitk probes for
known filenames; 'desikan'/'vascular' name files directly and win over 'root'.
